description: TabNest saves, groups and restores your browser tabs, so you never lose your work.
- Save all open tabs as a named session with one click
- Restore a session later, in the same window or a new one
- Group tabs by site and close duplicates
- Free up memory by suspending tabs you do not use
TabNest Pro costs $4.99 per year and adds sync between your computers.
Privacy: everything stays on your computer. TabNest does not collect or send any data.
